TCP::rcv_scale
Description
Returns the receive window scale advertised by the remote host.
Syntax
TCP::rcv_scale
Syntax
TCP
::
rcv_scale
TCP::rcv_scale
Return Value
The bitshift associated with the remote host window scale.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
# Log rcv_scale.
log
local0.
"rcv_scale: [TCP::rcv_scale]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ALL
